messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to define the telemetry contract for per-model/route SLO dashboards.
maya: Proposed metrics: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, ttft_ms, tokens_per_sec, avg_batch_size, queue_time_ms, rejection_rate.
arun: +1. Need to know which span of requests count as 'route' — path vs logical route id.
arun: Runtime can emit route_id tag on request metrics; we'll add route_id and model_name tags.
lucy: infra: push metrics to metrics-prod with these labels: env, region, model, route_id, instance_type.
lucy: we can add a telemetry topic 'slo-metrics' in Kafka for low-latency ingestion.
sam: ML: please include model_variant and quantization tags too — perf differs a lot.
oliver: Console: dashboards should support pivot by model or route and a time compare (24h/7d).
oliver: UX: default view = p95 latency + TTFT + tokens/sec; allow drilling into batch/queue histograms.
maya: Example prom query for p95 per model+route:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_name, route_id))
```
arun: For TTFT we should measure from request receive -> first token emitted. We'll emit first_token_latency_ms gauge per request.
sam: Also emit tokens_generated and wall_time to compute tokens/sec proxy.
lucy: On retention: keep high-cardinality SLO metrics at 1m resolution for 7d, rollup to 5m for 30d.
oliver: Can we add synthetic checks per route? simple p95/ttft alerts every 5m.
sre-bot: Incident policy note: if p95 > 500ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> page on-call.
deploy-bot: Canary note: include canary route flag so dashboards can filter by rollout.
maya: Action items: arun to add route_id/model tags + first_token metric; lucy to create kafka topic & retention policy; oliver to prototype Grafana panel; sam to ensure model_variant tags. Let's sync tomorrow 10am.
oliver: I'll put a dashboard PR draft in #eng-platform by EOD.
arun: I'll add the runtime emit in the next deploy, pinged infra for feature flag.
lucy: Will create infra ticket for topic + ingestion lambda.
sam: will add model_variant/quant flags to metric layer.
maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
